answer: Closed: gum is already in the system flake, so the chooser is `gum choose` over `zmux ls` output — no bespoke Go artifact and no second toolchain. A picker is therefore not shipped, which removes the last reason for a second language.
body: The crate is Rust; the chooser would have been a second artifact in a second language. Now answered by gum already being present.
title: One binary, or a Rust core with a Go chooser?
